conversations.invalid: Invalid conversation, message or text attachment.
conversations.changed: This conversation changed. Reload before saving.
conversations.agentDisabled: This Agent is disabled or archived.
conversations.directoryMissing: The Agent directory is missing or inaccessible.
conversations.cliMissing: The CLI is missing or its inspection failed.
conversations.loginRequired: Log in to the native CLI as the Runner account before starting.
conversations.bindingChanged: The execution account, CLI or directory changed. Create a new conversation.
conversations.busy: Wait for the active turn to finish or stop it first.
conversations.archived: This conversation is archived or interrupted. Reopen it or create a new conversation as appropriate.
conversations.staleDecision: This permission request is no longer active or already has a decision.
conversations.leaseLost: Execution ownership expired; further events and decisions were refused.
conversations.interrupted: Execution was interrupted. Retry the last message or keep typing to continue with a fresh native session and completed chat history. Check previous operation results before retrying; nothing is replayed automatically.
conversations.preflightFailed: The execution environment could not be verified. Check the Agent and Runner connection.
conversations.executionFailed: The native execution failed or disconnected. Check actual results before continuing.
conversations.outputLimit: Execution exceeded the output limit and was stopped.
conversations.fileTooLarge: Each file must be at most 32 MiB.
conversations.apiPending: API conversation execution is not available yet.
conversations.noRunner: No available Runner can execute this model.
conversations.cliPermissionUnsupported: This CLI supports read-only conversations only. Choose read-only access.
conversations.runnerUpgradeRequired: Upgrade the host Runner to enable platform tools before starting this conversation.
